The '''JZ-5g7 power convertor''' was a model of [[Power converter/Legends|power converter]] manufactured by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]]. The [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]] used four JZ-5g7 power convertors alongside a [[Vinop O2 K ionization reactor]] to feed the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] single [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex]] [[Kyromaster ion engine/Legends|Kyromaster]] [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]].<ref name="EGVV" />
